threat_event: Client CEII or BCSI exposed through project-wide permissions or personal cloud storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Project-wide groups; personal cloud storage not blocked; 2 of 25 sampled projects had client BCSI in personal storage
regulatory_driver: Client CIP-011-3 terms; 18 CFR 388.113 handling terms
existing_controls: Restricted CEII folders on 60% of projects
treatment_plan: Restricted folders for every CEII or BCSI project; block personal storage

threat_event: Missed client incident notice (24 to 72 hours)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No register of the 41 client notice terms; no route from SOC findings
existing_controls: Contracts director handles notices case by case
treatment_plan: Client notice register; SOC routing; include in the group matrix (P08)

threat_event: Commissioning laptop carries malware into a client substation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 700 laptops used as Transient Cyber Assets; 6% missed the pre-visit scan in 2026
regulatory_driver: Client Transient Cyber Asset terms (CIP-010-4 R4; CIP-003-9 Sec. 5)
treatment_plan: Scan enforced by device policy before any client network connection

threat_event: AI design assistant leaks client documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot used with client documents before approval
existing_controls: Blocked for CEII and BCSI folders since 2026-08
treatment_plan: Client consent clause; no-training terms confirmed (P10)

threat_event: Phished engineer account used against client or affiliate systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers hold access at many clients; MFA through SYS-G1 but not phishing resistant
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for engineers with client or TCC access

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts and steals Grid Engineering archives on legacy group file servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Archives on legacy file servers with broad permissions
regulatory_driver: Client CIP-011-3 terms; client confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Migrate archives to SYS-S1 restricted folders

threat_event: SOC 2 Type 2 exceptions from undocumented inheritance and 90-day log retention
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance not documented; 2023 standard keeps 90 days of platform logs
owner: Grid Engineering security and compliance lead

threat_event: FCI exposed on federal contract projects
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI projects on the same platform with restricted folders
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the division security and compliance lead
owner: Division security and compliance lead (Grid Engineering)

threat_event: Late access revocation at clients for departing engineers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client access lists kept by project managers
treatment_plan: Automated notice from the client access register

threat_event: Protection settings files altered before deployment at a client substation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Settings files checked by peer review, not by hash
existing_controls: Peer review and client approval of settings
treatment_plan: Hash settings at approval; verify at deployment

existing_controls: Exit interviews; access removal within 4 hours

threat_event: Intercompany services agreement has no security schedule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2020 agreement predates the utility CIP-013-2 plan
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-013-2 R1) via the Electric Utility
existing_controls: Utility CIP-013-2 plan treats the division as a vendor
treatment_plan: OT security schedule in the agreement (GR-05)
